description: Find published places to eat and drink in Queenstown, Wanaka, Arrowtown and Te Anau by area, type, price band, name or cuisine text, and whether they are open now (New Zealand time). Business details only, no booking.

openNow.description: Only venues whose structured hours say open right now in New Zealand time

query.description: Text matched against name, cuisine, type and suburb, e.g. "thai", "bakery", "frankton"

name: find_places_to_eat
